This training program is designed for new hires and job offer recipients. Participants will learn the mindset and fundamentals of working life, including practical business etiquette, appropriate language and communication, and the importance of workplace teamwork and collaboration. The program uses group work activities to make learning hands-on and practical. Please consider using this for your company's employee development.
